zoysia.e: After Karl von Zois zu Laubach, Austrian botanist.

s.d: any of several creeping grasses of the genus Zoysia

Any member of species of the genus (Zoysia) of creeping perennial grasses of southern Asia and New Zealand having fine, wiry leaves and including some suitable for lawn grasses, especially in warm regions.
x: In areas farther north, zoysias will live but will not spread. Zoysias need bright, hot sunlight.
